verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents concurrency limits, rate limits, or queue behavior for batch rendering. The closest item is a marketing claim of 'dedicated capacity with guaranteed throughput and latency' for production workloads [luma-docs-20], which states no actual limits or queue semantics. Credit-based pricing [luma-docs-15, luma-docs-19] covers cost, not concurrency, so it is an adjacent feature that earns no credit.
